narrative: Major breakthrough round, direct continuation of round 15's pillar-growth discovery. GROWING THE PILLAR BEFORE FALLING THROUGH ITS SHAFT MAKES THE FALL SAFE: (1) click the true-start pillar to grow it (round 15's trick), (2) flip gravity up via the near start-room switch, (3) slide right twice to reach column ~32-33 -- squarely within the vertical gap at cols31-47 discovered this round in the wall band separating the up-gravity and down-gravity rooms (a genuine, previously-unnoticed opening; earlier rounds had only sampled columns outside this range and wrongly concluded the wall was fully solid), (4) flip gravity back down from within that gap column using the far/second switch. Without pre-growing the pillar, this exact fall is INSTANT DEATH (independently confirmed both with and without the grow-first step, isolating pillar-growth as the deciding factor) -- but with the pillar grown first, the player survives and lands in an entirely new, previously-unreachable room at the base of the (now-grown) pillar. This new room reveals, for the first time in live play (not just the generic death-overview): three E-tile doors in a row (matching round 13's death-overview sighting, now confirmed reachable), a long row of five pillars with the classic B0B eye signature, and -- critically -- what appears to be either a fresh third switch pair or the same switches re-rendered from a new camera angle (clicking it consumed BOTH remaining color-8 pixel clusters at once and flipped gravity again, carrying the player back up to the familiar up-gravity resting room). From that up-gravity room, both LEFT and RIGHT exploration are now fully safe (left wall ~col15, right wall ~col57, matching rooms mapped in round 14), passing directly through the horizontal span below the newly-found pillar/door cluster without incident (the hazards there occupy a different, higher row band than this corridor). With all switches now exhausted (color-8 count is 0 platform-wide), no further gravity change is available, and the goal diamond -- visible again from this familiar up-gravity vantage point -- remains unreached; this session's switch budget is spent. No new level banked; frontier stays at level 8, but the wall-gap + pillar-growth-enables-safe-fall mechanism is now understood and is the strongest lead yet for a fresh attempt.
novel_mechanics_found: THE FLOOR SEPARATING THE UP- AND DOWN-GRAVITY ROOMS HAS A REAL GAP at cols~31-47 (not fully solid, contra round 14's column-limited sampling) -- this gap is occupied by the pillar first seen from true start, and falling through it in either gravity direction ordinarily kills the player (confirmed fatal both with a fresh pillar and, separately, when the pillar had not yet been grown).

GROWING THE PILLAR FIRST (round 15's click-to-grow trick) MAKES A FALL THROUGH ITS SHAFT SURVIVABLE -- directly isolated by testing the identical fall with vs without the pre-growth step. This is the key unlock: the pillar's growable state doubles as a traversal mechanic, not just a curiosity.

Falling through the grown pillar's shaft lands the player in a genuinely new room (not visible from any previously-reached camera position) containing 3 E-doors and a 5-pillar gauntlet, and what functions as one more usable switch-click (consumed both remaining color-8 clusters and flipped gravity), all now confirmed reachable in live play rather than only visible in the generic death-overview.
dead_ends: All switches are now exhausted this round's playthrough (color-8 count reaches 0 after the breakthrough sequence's final click). The doors found in the new room were NOT interacted with this round (only observed) -- their open/soft-lock behavior for this specific level is still unknown and is the natural next probe.
